name: Jangolode Mine
label: Place
description: In Westfall’s rolling hills, the Defias Brotherhood works Jangolode Mine for itself. The mine once supplied Stormwind City with ore and raw materials.
intro: In Westfall’s rolling hills, the Defias Brotherhood works Jangolode Mine for itself. The mine once supplied Stormwind City with ore and raw materials.

p: Before Westfall declined, Jangolode Mine sent metals to Stormwind City for its reconstruction and supply. As civil order weakened and the kingdom withdrew its garrisons, the Defias Brotherhood seized the mine to support its own operations. The bandits now work its rich veins and defend the shafts fiercely.
